CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_guard_image_eligible(p_question text, p_text_sha text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select exists(
 select 1 from public.ai_guard_requests r join public.question_explanation_overrides o on o.question_id=r.question_id
 where r.question_id=p_question and r.result_committed and r.state='closed' and r.action_kind='explanation'
 and o.replacement_revision is null and o.updated_at between r.created_at and r.closed_at
 and encode(sha256(convert_to(o.explanation,'UTF8')),'hex')=p_text_sha
 and not exists(select 1 from public.ai_guard_reviewed_questions q join public.ai_guard_reviewed_state s on s.id and q.generation=s.generation where q.question_id=p_question))
 or exists(
 select 1 from public.explanation_replacement_versions v join public.ai_guard_requests r on r.id=v.request_id
 join public.question_explanation_overrides o on o.question_id=v.question_id and o.replacement_revision=v.request_id
 where v.question_id=p_question and v.committed_at is not null and v.restored_at is null
 and r.actor_id=v.actor_id and r.question_id=v.question_id and r.result_committed and r.state='closed' and r.action_kind='explanation'
 and (v.after_snapshot-'figure_status')=(to_jsonb(o)-'figure_status')
 and encode(sha256(convert_to(o.explanation,'UTF8')),'hex')=p_text_sha
 and exists(select 1 from public.ai_guard_calls c where c.request_id=r.id and c.seq=1 and c.state='settled')
 and not exists(select 1 from public.ai_guard_calls c where c.request_id=r.id and c.state<>'settled'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.figure_model_unknown(p_operation uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'figure_model_private'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 UPDATE figure_model_private.operations SET state='unknown' WHERE operation_id=p_operation AND state IN ('reserved','sent');
 IF FOUND THEN INSERT INTO figure_model_private.events(operation_id,event) VALUES(p_operation,'unknown');END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.figure_model_policy()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'figure_model_private'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('enabled',b.enabled AND b.model_enabled AND coalesce(((b.funding_mode='cash_authorized' AND b.cash_authorized AND b.funding_evidence_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') OR (b.funding_mode='verified_credit' AND b.no_cash AND b.credit_until>clock_timestamp() AND a.verified_credit_expires_at>clock_timestamp())),false) AND a.enabled,
 'model',b.model,'pricingRevision',b.pricing_revision,'reserveMicroUsd',b.reserve_cost,'maxOutputTokens',b.max_output_tokens,
 'maxInputTokens',b.max_input_tokens,'inputRate',b.input_rate,'outputRate',b.output_rate,
 'creditVerified',b.credit_until>clock_timestamp(),'noCash',b.no_cash,'fundingMode',b.funding_mode,'cashAuthorized',b.cash_authorized,'fundingEvidenceSha',b.funding_evidence_sha)
 FROM figure_model_private.batch b JOIN public.ai_guard_budget a ON a.id=b.id WHERE b.id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.figure_model_locked_text(p_question text, p_text_sha text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE txt text; BEGIN
 IF p_question IS NULL OR p_text_sha IS NULL OR p_text_sha !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT explanation INTO txt FROM public.question_explanation_overrides
 WHERE question_id=p_question AND encode(sha256(convert_to(explanation,'UTF8')),'hex')=p_text_sha FOR SHARE;
 RETURN txt;
END $function$

name: public.figure_text_cash_allowed
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.figure_text_cash_allowed(p_id uuid, p_actor uuid, p_question text, p_base text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'figure_model_private'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM figure_model_private.text_plans p JOIN figure_model_private.batch b ON b.id
 JOIN public.question_explanation_overrides e ON e.question_id=p.question_id
 WHERE p.request_id=p_id AND p.actor_id=p_actor AND p.question_id=p_question AND p.base_version=p_base
 AND b.enabled AND b.cash_authorized AND b.funding_mode='cash_authorized' AND b.funding_evidence_sha~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 AND b.actor_id=p.actor_id AND p.question_id=ANY(b.targets) AND b.charged<=b.cap
 AND encode(sha256(convert_to(e.explanation,'UTF8')),'hex')=p.text_sha
 AND public.explanation_replacement_base(p.question_id)->>'version'=p.base_version)
$function$

name: public.figure_text_commit_lock
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.figure_text_commit_lock(p_id uuid, p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.ai_guard_requests r JOIN public.explanation_replacement_versions v ON v.request_id=r.id
 WHERE r.id=p_id AND r.actor_id=p_actor AND v.actor_id=p_actor AND (r.state='active' OR (r.result_committed AND v.committed_at IS NOT NULL))) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'replacement lock scope';END IF;
 LOCK TABLE public.question_explanation_overrides IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION explanation_private.explanation_generation_stage(p_id uuid, p_actor uuid, p_options text[], p_response jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'explanation_private'
AS $function$
declare r public.ai_guard_requests%rowtype; old explanation_private.generation_results%rowtype;
begin
 select * into r from public.ai_guard_requests where id=p_id for update;
 if not found or p_actor is null or r.actor_id is distinct from p_actor or r.state<>'active' or r.result_committed or r.call_limit<>1
 or exists(select 1 from public.explanation_replacement_versions where request_id=p_id)
 or not exists(select 1 from public.ai_guard_calls where request_id=p_id and seq=1 and state in ('started','settled'))
 or p_options is null or cardinality(p_options) not between 1 and 5
 or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_options) k where k is null or k !~ '^[A-E]$')
 or cardinality(p_options)<>(select count(distinct k) from unnest(p_options) k)
 or p_response is null or jsonb_typeof(p_response)<>'object' or octet_length(p_response::text)>262144
 or jsonb_typeof(p_response->'rawText') is distinct from 'string'
 or coalesce(length(p_response->>'rawText'),0)=0 then return 'invalid';end if;
 select * into old from explanation_private.generation_results where request_id=p_id;
 if found then return case when old.actor_id=p_actor and old.required_options=p_options and old.response=p_response then 'saved' else 'conflict' end;end if;
 insert into explanation_private.generation_results(request_id,actor_id,required_options,response,response_sha)
 values(p_id,p_actor,p_options,p_response,encode(sha256(convert_to(p_response::text,'UTF8')),'hex'));
 return 'saved';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION explanation_private.explanation_sitewide_image_plans()

 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'explanation_private'
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.payload),'[]'::jsonb) from (
  select jsonb_build_object('request_id',j.request_id,'state',j.state,'attempts',j.attempts,'needs_state',j.needs_state,'figure_needs',j.figure_needs) as payload
  from public.figure_queue_jobs j join explanation_private.sitewide_requests s on s.request_id=j.request_id join public.ai_guard_requests r on r.id=s.request_id
  where j.state='pending' and j.attempts=0 and j.needs_state='awaiting' and r.result_committed and public.explanation_sitewide_request_allowed(r.id,r.actor_id)
  and not exists(select 1 from explanation_private.sitewide_image_plan_holds h where h.request_id=j.request_id and h.revision=encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(j.figure_needs,'null'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'))
  order by j.created_at limit 20
 ) x
$function$

name: explanation_private.sitewide_image_binding
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION explanation_private.sitewide_image_binding(p_id uuid, p_question text, p_text_sha text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'explanation_private'
AS $function$
 select p_id is not null and p_question is not null and p_text_sha ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and exists(
  select 1 from explanation_private.sitewide_requests s
  join public.ai_guard_requests r on r.id=s.request_id and r.actor_id=s.actor_id and r.question_id=s.question_id
  join explanation_private.generation_results g on g.request_id=r.id and g.actor_id=r.actor_id
  where s.request_id=p_id and s.question_id=p_question and s.action in ('generate','replace')
  and r.result_committed and r.call_limit=1 and r.action_kind='explanation'
  and g.response_sha=encode(sha256(convert_to(g.response::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
  and g.response->>'model'=r.model
  and encode(sha256(convert_to(g.response->'value'->>'explanation','UTF8')),'hex')=p_text_sha
  and exists(select 1 from public.ai_guard_calls c where c.request_id=r.id and c.seq=1 and c.state='settled')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.ai_guard_calls c where c.request_id=r.id and c.state<>'settled')
 )
$function$
